Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which 
must be carried out every nine month as indicated by M9 in the above title 
block.
This equipment 
used for clean intake water from any deposits suspended.
The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy, tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Ahmad Shana , revised by maintenance general
